description: This is the entry point script for running a FastAPI application with Uvicorn, a Python ASGI server. It initializes and starts the server on a configurable host and port, with default values set to host '0.0.0.0' and port 3001.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Starts the Uvicorn server hosting the FastAPI app, configured via environment variables for host and port.
